entries.speaker: Lively Shopkeeper
entries.en: Welcome! We've got plenty of new stock[n]just in time for winter!

entries.speaker: Loud Shopkeeper
entries.en: Up to a fifteen percent discount with the[n]purchase of two or more items! Stop by[n]quick, while the offer's still good!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: It's so energetic... I'm nearly unable to[n]feel the cold here...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Crowds come to fulfill their material wants[n]while the vendors seek their profits. This[n]place is a whirlpool of human desire.

entries.speaker: Young Lady
entries.en: It's cute, but it's kinda pricey...

entries.speaker: Young Lady
entries.en: Ah, it'll be fine. I'm treating myself today[n]anyway.

entries.speaker: Office Worker Lady
entries.en: This one, please! My bonus ought to[n]cover it...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: It seems that the words "sale" and "bonus"[n]carry extra weight in this place.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Humans are incapable of resisting such[n]simple temptation... How foolish.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: That reminds me—it looks like a lot of[n]people who fell prey to their pitiful[n]desires come to places like this.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I hear the term used for such people is[n]"lovey-dovey" or something like that.[n]Is that what's going on here?
That's not the exact definition.
They're usually in pairs.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: That's right, "lovey-dovey" is supposed[n]to mean a harmonious relationship of[n]two people doting on one another.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: I've also heard that such pairings emanate[n]a special aura that incites the rage of[n]those around them.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Let's track down some lovey-dovey[n]people, Inmate!

entries.speaker: Woman in Relationship
entries.en: Ohmygosh, this is so cute!

entries.speaker: Jewelry Shopkeeper
entries.en: Oh, that piece came in just yesterday.[n]We also have a men's version in stock.

entries.speaker: Man in Relationship
entries.en: That looks gorgeous on you! Should we[n]get a matching pair, sweetie?

entries.speaker: Woman in Relationship
entries.en: Aw, you sure? But it's so expensive...[n]I'd feel so baaad...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Yep, that's lovey-dovey. It's so obvious,[n]I don't even need to ask.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Their aura is so irritating, words can't[n]describe it.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: On the other hand, I've heard that[n]lovey-dovey individuals are actually[n]secretly envied by many in society.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Could you be one of the envious?
I am.
I'm not.
I'm lovey-dovey already.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Well, give it up. You don't have a chance[n]in a world like that, Inmate.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Just be grateful we're willing to be seen[n]with you—for now!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Tryin' to look tough for us? That just makes[n]you even more pathetic.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: I must agree... This pity is what led to[n]our being here with you now.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: You should show a little more gratitude.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You're WHAT!?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: So you're just another beast driven by[n]its primal desires... How repulsive.[n]Please keep your distance from us.

entries.speaker: Man in Relationship
entries.en: Well, if we get the silver ones, I can maybe[n]afford a pair of—

entries.speaker: Man in Relationship
entries.en: HUH!? A h-hundred thousan—

entries.speaker: Jewelry Shopkeeper
entries.en: This one's 100 percent platinum. It never[n]rusts, so it's a perfect expression of your[n]eternal love.

entries.speaker: Woman in Relationship
entries.en: Awww, eternal love! That's the one!

entries.speaker: Man in Relationship
entries.en: Oh, yeah, but... but I kinda think the one[n]next to it has a... better design.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: The atmosphere's shifted...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Yep... A storm's coming.

entries.speaker: Woman in Relationship
entries.en: ExCUSE me, you must be pointing to the[n]wrong row—or are you trying to say that[n]one's what I'm worth to you? Is THAT it!?

entries.speaker: Man in Relationship
entries.en: No no no, that's not what I'm saying...[n]It's just, it's a little over budget, is all...

entries.speaker: Woman in Relationship
entries.en: How awful... I thought our love was eternal,[n]but instead it's just some cheap imitation[n]of the real thing!

entries.speaker: Woman in Relationship
entries.en: If it's all bound to fall apart, we might[n]as well end it now...

entries.speaker: Man in Relationship
entries.en: Nooo, I'm sorry, I'm sorry! I'll buy it.[n]Excuse me, I'll take this one!

entries.speaker: Man in Relationship
entries.en: But—just the one, please. Not the pair...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: The clash of the lovey-dovey shoppers[n]has been decided.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Hmph. Pretty one-sided clash...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Why'd that man end up doing[n]whatever the woman said? What[n]sort of subservience is this?
He's hypnotized.
Love is enchanting.
It's just what lovers do.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Hypnotized... So you mean his mind[n]was being manipulated?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Not only that, she even managed to extort[n]money from him... A lovey-dovey human's[n]desires run deep indeed.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Enchanting? So that woman is a powerful[n]spellcaster?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: I see. Not only did she keep him spell-[n]bound, but she managed to cajole quite[n]a sum of money from him as well...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: That's a rather impressive skillset.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I've heard of such foolishness befalling[n]lovers before. This must be what they[n]mean when they say "love is blind."

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: How terrifying love is, that it can render[n]an individual so useless. Be careful,[n]Inmate.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: The rumors about this chaotic battlefield[n]were true after all.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: To think they can generate so much[n]disorder just by coming together...[n]Humans are such strange beings.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: However, upon realizing that is a source of[n]their power, it's easy to see how this place[n]has aided the Inmate's rehabilitation.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Humans truly are fascinating.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Anyway, we hereby acknowledge the[n]completion of your assignment.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Here is your reward.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: That finishes up the last of our special[n]assignments...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I was expecting you to give up partway[n]through. Not too bad at all, Inmate!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: The strength of spirit you've displayed[n]while carrying out your rehabilitation...[n]That deserves our recognition.
It's all thanks to you two.
Thanks.
Keep going...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: So you've finally learned to show us[n]respect, huh? You've come a long way!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Please continue such strong efforts[n]towards your rehabilitation.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: That response sounds as if you're[n]beginning to relax.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Your rehabilitation is not nearly through.[n]Do not grow complacent.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Don't get so full of yourself, Inmate!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Your rehabilitation isn't through yet![n]You better not lose sight of your goal!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Hm? Speaking of which...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Humans seem unusually predisposed to[n]giving each other money and material[n]goods if they're closely related.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: People buying one another's affection![n]Doesn't that sound pathetic, Inmate?
It's an expression of gratitude.
There's no ulterior motive.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Oh? And don't you think there are people[n]you should express some gratitude towards[n]right now?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Indeed. I think a certain pair of exceptional[n]wardens deserve a little something for[n]observing their troublesome Inmate.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Oh? So it's just a gesture of respect,[n]nothing more?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: I think a certain pair of exceptional[n]wardens deserve a little respect for[n]observing their troublesome Inmate.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: That was a joke, Inmate. We are not so low[n]as to exploit you for material gain.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Say, Justine—shouldn't we buy something[n]for our master while we're here?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: There appears to be a delivery service we[n]can take advantage of here. Perhaps they[n]can ship packages directly to our world?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Let us inspect the area a bit longer.
After lugging around their[n]shopping bags, I escorted the[n]twins back to the Velvet Room...
